loss: outcome MSE + legal-mask recorded-move cross entropy, equal coefficients
target: side-to-move recorded outcome +1/0/-1; recorded move, including pass token 64 where applicable
architecture: own/opponent planes -> Conv3x3 C/ReLU -> Conv3x3 C/ReLU -> Flatten -> Linear64/ReLU -> value Linear1/tanh and policy Linear65; no BN, pooling, residual or frozen weights

dataset.filters: complete games; placements 8..56, stride 3; 8-symmetry/color-relative position dedup; test/validation ownership before train
dataset.split: native converter canonical first 8 moves; no move-wise split
dataset.target: recorded final black disc difference / 64, from side-to-move view

labels.label: first same-split, same-board/turn and same-outcome recorded next move
labels.split: unchanged frozen opening-group splits and symmetry-deduplicated positions
labels.passPolicy: existing cache excludes pass targets; forced pass is deterministic at inference

selection: each model and overall winner by frozen validation MSE+CE; test evaluated only after all training is finished; no test tuning
export: PyTorch state_dict and CPU TorchScript; offline only, no native search loader

recovery.reason: Training/evaluation finished; report assembly raised duplicate maxEpochs keyword
